Verse 16
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son
Adam Clarke Commentary
For God so loved the world - Such a love as that which induced God to give his only begotten son to die for the world.
From the subject before him, let the reader attend to the following particulars.

Calvin's Commentary on the Bible
16. For God so loved the world. Christ opens up the first cause, and, as it were, the source of our salvation, and he does so, that no doubt may remain.

Calvin, John. "Commentary on John 3:16". "Calvin's Commentary on the Bible". 1840-57.

Robertson's Word Pictures
So (houtws). The aorist ēgapēsen points to the definite act of love in the gift of the Son. Monogenēs means only, unique.
Bibliographical Information
Robertson, A.T. "Commentary on John 3:16". "Robertson's Word Pictures of the New Testament". Broadman Press 1932,33.
Expository Notes of Dr. Thomas Constable
This verse is probably the most familiar in the Bible; it summarises the gospel message that John has been developing.
